HELP.what_is_this: This file controls every product on the website. If you add/edit items here, the site updates automatically.
HELP.how_to_feature_items: To show an item in the small 'Featured Picks' carousel, set 'featured' to true. To hide it from the carousel, set 'featured' to false.
how_to_add_a_new_item: Copy one of the items below (everything inside { } ), paste it at the bottom of the list BEFORE the last ]
Change the id to a new number that is NOT already used
Change the name, price, image, category, and featured fields
Make sure every item has a comma after it EXCEPT the very last one

field_explanations.id: A unique number for the product. Every product must have a different id.
field_explanations.name: The product name shown on the website.
field_explanations.price: The price as a number. Example: 19.99 (do not use a $ sign).
field_explanations.image: The image file path inside the /images folder. Example: men/mens_jacket.jpg
field_explanations.category: Where it shows up: men, women, or electronics.
field_explanations.featured: true = shows in Featured Picks carousel, false = does not

common_mistakes: Do not delete commas between items
Do not put a comma after the LAST item
Make sure image paths match the file names exactly
